POSITION_SIZING_STATUS.rounding: down only; a reduction can never raise the modelled loss

MARGIN_STATUS.initial_margin: notional / min(requested, policy cap, venue bracket ceiling)
MARGIN_STATUS.maintenance_margin: notional * bracket rate - cumulative maintenance amount

LIQUIDATION_STATUS.model: closed form of the venue's isolated margin condition

defect_found_and_fixed.summary: the long-side closed form subtracted the adverse funding/liquidation terms instead of adding them, which OVER-stated the distance to liquidation
defect_found_and_fixed.found_by: the independent verifier's numeric root of the margin condition

FUNDING_STATUS.interval_source: observed settlement timestamps of the venue funding endpoint
FUNDING_STATUS.zero_funding_rule: zero only when the venue interval proves no settlement falls inside the horizon; a settlement horizon without published rates is COST_UNKNOWN

concurrency_probe.probe: 8 concurrent decisions on one equity pool of 200 USDT

TEST_RESULTS.mypy: Success: no issues found in 10 source files
TEST_RESULTS.ruff: clean on every touched python file
invariants: a costlier assumption never approves a bigger size
effective leverage <= min(requested, policy, venue ceiling)
no decision ever authorises an order

31 decisions and 303 checks reproduced by a verifier that loads no builder module (loaded: none); 8/8 negative controls detected
the 24 cases of §12 in tests/unit/risk/test_futures_risk_engine.py plus property/invariant tests and an 8-way concurrency probe on one equity pool

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.requirement: evidence of real offline engine execution
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.evidence: 31 scenarios executed offline (8 approvals, 23 refusals); reproducible=True
order_authorised_anywhere=False; no credentials and no live REST path in the package; the DecisionEngine refuses a futures review that could authorise an order
ECONOMIC_FEASIBILITY.json compares spot vs 1x/2x/3x/5x under frozen assumptions (same notional and same capital); leverage_creates_alpha=false; regenerated deterministically by scripts/rfc048_run.py

DEFECTS.summary: long-side liquidation algebra sign error (over-stated the buffer)
an empty funding history with a settled horizon was treated as a zero funding cost instead of COST_UNKNOWN
the margin model's unknown-assessment helper was called with a misnamed argument on two unreachable paths (latent TypeError)
